title: Tensor networks for quantum computing
abstract: Comprehensive review of tensor network applications in quantum computing: simulation of quantum computation, circuit synthesis, error correction and mitigation, and machine learning. Covers MERA for critical states, holographic simulation, and quantum computational advantage. Collaboration of 30+ researchers from JPMorganChase, NVIDIA, Terra Quantum, Google, NASA, Quantinuum, and top academic institutions. Notes criticisms of MERA as direct AdS/CFT realization due to preferred directions from unitary/isometric tensors, but acknowledges MERA captures key aspects of holography.
key_claims: Comprehensive review of tensor network methods across quantum computing domains
MERA suited for describing critical ground states and viewed as spatial slice of holographic AdS spacetime
Criticisms exist against MERA as direct AdS/CFT realization due to preferred directions
Tensor networks crucial for understanding and achieving quantum computational advantage
Published in Nature Reviews Physics -- establishes tensor networks as mainstream QC tool
